name: neuroworks
description: NeuroWorks local-first AI workforce platform (clawbot cron worker + web console).

scripts.dev: node tools/dev-lock.mjs && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F neuroworks-server dev" "pnpm -F neuroworks-web dev"
scripts.dev:theia: node tools/dev-lock.mjs && concurrently -n server,web,theia -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm -F neuroworks-server dev" "pnpm -F neuroworks-web dev" "pnpm -F @naxion/theia-app theia start --port 7472"
scripts.secondary: cross-env NAXION_NAME=secondary NAXION_ROLE=persona-shifter NAXION_PORT=7473 NAXION_PEERS=http://127.0.0.1:7471 NAXION_SUBAGENT_BUDGET=4 NAXION_IO_BUDGET=8 pnpm -F neuroworks-server dev
